2608.25973.title: SciMIF: Understanding Multimodal Instruction Following in Scientific Domains
2608.25973.paper_summary: Understanding instruction-following capabilities in scientific domains is essential for effectively leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to advance the development of scientific fields. In this work, we introduce SciMIF, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the capability of MLLMs in following complex scientific instructions. Specifically, based on an extensive analysis of 22 distinct tasks across 5 representative scientific disciplines, we propose a comprehensive taxonomy comprising 10 constraint groups that captures both general functional requirements and discipline-specific characteristics. Guided by this taxonomy, we develop a high-fidelity instruction injection pipeline to systematically augment existing scientific datasets. We conduct comprehensive experiments on multiple state-of-the-art closed-source and open-source MLLMs. Our findings reveal significant performance disparities across different scientific disciplines, with chemistry posing greater challenges for current MLLMs. Furthermore, we observe that increasing the model scale does not yield corresponding improvements in constraint adherence, and current models still struggle severely with fine-grained constraints and instructions requiring the deep application of disciplinary knowledge. SciMIF fills the current void in evaluating multimodal instruction adherence within scientific domains, laying a crucial foundation for future enhancements of MLLMs in rigorous scientific applications. Data and code will be released at https://github.com/shenye7436/SciMIF .
2608.25973.paper_summary_zh: 理解科學領域中的指令遵循能力對於有效利用多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）以推進科學領域的發展至關重要。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們介紹了SciMIF，一個旨在評估MLLMs遵循複雜科學指令能力的新基準。<lb/>具體而言，基於對5個代表性科學學科中22個不同任務的廣泛分析，我們提出了一個包含10個約束組的綜合分類法，捕捉了通用功能需求和學科特定特徵。<lb/>在這一分類法的指導下，我們開發了一個高保真度的指令注入管道，以系統性地增強現有的科學數據集。<lb/>我們對多個最先進的封閉源和開放源MLLMs進行了全面實驗。<lb/>我們的發現揭示了不同科學學科之間顯著的性能差異，化學領域對當前的MLLMs提出了更大的挑戰。<lb/>此外，我們觀察到增加模型規模並未帶來相應的約束遵循改進，當前模型在細粒度約束和需要深入應用學科知識的指令上仍然面臨嚴重困難。<lb/>SciMIF填補了目前在科學領域中評估多模態指令遵循的空白，為未來在嚴謹科學應用中增強MLLMs奠定了重要基礎。<lb/>數據和代碼將在 https://github.com/shenye7436/SciMIF 上發布。
